verdict.line: You lose most 1v1s and solo kills through level 5-6, but Fiora's itemization flips this to a 55.4% win rate over 148 games once either side hits a first back.

brief.thesis: Sett's Knuckle Down (Q, cooldown 9/8/7/6/5s) empowers his next two basic attacks off max health, and Facebreaker (E, cooldown 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, range 490) can stun if he pulls enemies from opposite sides - Fiora has no hard CC to punish either, only Riposte's (W) single-attack parry. This forces a passive laning pattern where Fiora banks Duelist healing stacks and Lunge (Q) pokes instead of trading autos, waiting for Ravenous Hydra and Trinity Force to out-scale Sett's flat damage.

theirWindow.when: Knuckle Down active + minion opposite you
theirWindow.what: His next two basic attacks deal bonus max-health damage, and if a minion sits opposite you from Sett his Facebreaker pull becomes a stun instead of a slow - back off wave control the moment you see the Q proc.

yourWindow.when: Riposte (W) up when he commits Q
yourWindow.what: Hold W for the second empowered auto from Knuckle Down - parrying it denies the bonus damage, reflects magic damage back, and the AD boost from an active Riposte turns the punish into a real trade.

powerCurve.note: Higher base damage, Q autos win early trades
Parry timing catches up to his ult threat
Hydra/Trinity spike outscales his flat damage
Full build and stacked Duelist win duels

start.why: Run in 83.1% of games (51.2% win rate over 162) - the extra sustain from Duelist procs matters more here than shield scaling since you're absorbing Q-empowered autos, not poke.

boots.why: 86.8% pick rate (57% win rate over 151 games) - Sett's damage is almost entirely basic attacks (his alternating punches plus Q-empowered autos), so flat auto reduction is worth more than magic resist here.

core.why: First item in the 39.8%-pick, 51.2%-win path - the sustain and wave clear let you survive to your power spike without contesting early trades.
Adds the burst and move speed that pairs with Burst of Speed (E) to actually win a duel once you're no longer just surviving.
Closes out the top build path (51.2% win rate) - critical against Sett's true-damage Haymaker punch, since it lets your Duelist healing outpace his burst windows.

situational.when: you get an early lead and want to convert it into an all-in power spike instead of scaling passively
the lane turns into a long poke-and-farm stalemate and you need extra sustain damage
fights are running long and you want the cooldown reduction to loop Q resets and W parries faster

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-pick page (44%, 13.2% pick) - stacking Conqueror during the safe poke phase pays off once you reach your item spike and start winning extended trades. Note: master-tier Fiora players (1,347 games) run Press the Attack instead - better suited if you're confident landing clean burst trades rather than grinding out longer fights.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the default (77.7% pick, 53.4% win rate) for punishing him if he overextends post-parry. Flash+Teleport actually posts the highest measured win rate here (58.8% over a smaller sample) and fits the scale-and-splitpush plan this matchup rewards - take it if you expect a slow lane.

playing.title: Hold W for his Q auto
playing.detail: Riposte only parries the next basic attack, so time it for the second empowered swing from Knuckle Down rather than throwing it away on a normal poke.

playing.title: Track minion position on Facebreaker
playing.detail: His E only stuns if he pulls enemies from opposite sides; if you're alone on one side it just slows. Position so you're never the lone target opposite a minion.

playing.title: Poke with Q, not autos
playing.detail: Lunge lets you hit and reset within its double-dash window at no mana cost - use it to chip damage without standing in easy Q-empowered auto range.

playing.title: Don't all-in before your first back
playing.detail: The data shows Sett owns solo kills early; wait for Ravenous Hydra before initiating any extended trade.

playing.title: Respect level 6 The Show Stopper
playing.detail: Cooldown is 120/100/80/80/80s and range is only 400, so simply staying outside dash range denies it entirely - don't overextend on wave once he hits 6.

playing.title: Use E to disengage after a parry
playing.detail: Burst of Speed grants move speed on every attack or Lunge landed while active, so trigger it right after a successful Riposte punish to peel out before his Grit resets.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch (148 head-to-head games); the mechanical reasoning and lane-plan tying those numbers together is my own read of the ability kits.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Sett activate his (P) by constantly dealing damage with [Q]. Use [W] to block any of his skills to gain the upper hand in combat.
